Source: [8904](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8904); edited 2026-05-25. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Index Of Array Value](../../api/values/index-of-array-value.md).

<a id="wiki-8904-n1"></a>

<a id="wiki-8904-n2"></a>

- Article says a 1D-array search value uses its first element and searches a fully flattened source; vector or nested-array search uses strict exact matching instead.
